title: Chapter 1379 - 4: Lin Yuan Takes Action

Chapter 1379 - 4: Lin Yuan Takes Action

Chapter 1379: Chapter 4: Lin Yuan Takes Action

With Lin Yuan’s support, Lord Mo Xu felt quite confident.

Otherwise, knowing that a Second Realm time life form was stirring up trouble behind the scenes,

Lord Mo Xu would most likely not choose to resist head-on.

A Second Realm time life form is not as formidable as a Time Lord.

It can completely kill a time life form.

But offending a Second Realm time life form would be a headache for most First Realm time life forms.

Under the calculations and schemes of a Second Realm time life form, a First Realm time life form would fall into passivity.

...

The Heavenly River Water surged, sweeping toward Lord Mo Xu under the urging of the Master of Taixu.

Layers of Heavenly River Water rippled like waves on the water’s surface.

Continuously spreading, continuously stacking, causing its might to grow larger and larger.

Faintly carrying the force of nearly half a Milky Way dimension.

"Taixu, with these methods, you won’t be able to deal with me."

Lord Mo Xu shook his head slightly, also drawing on the Heavenly River Water. Having presided over the Milky Way dimension for many years, he was more familiar than the Master of Taixu with the power of this dimensional space.

Sure enough.

The two completely different rule forces continually collided and melted away, eventually rendering the Master of Taixu’s strike ineffective.

The Master of Taixu’s expression was calm, without much surprise.

He had seen this scene in many future timelines.

Relying solely on his own methods, without paying a huge price,

Any battle with Lord Mo Xu would basically result in a stalemate.

And his chances of winning would even be slightly smaller.

"It’s not urgent now."

The Master of Taixu suppressed the urge to directly use the ’axe’ given by the Gray Ancestor.

The Heart of Heavenly River has not yet formed, even if they defeat the seven time life forms in the Chaos Void,

they wouldn’t be able to immediately seize the Heart of Heavenly River.

This way, it would bring about many variables.

For instance, attracting the attention of other Second Realm time life forms?

Only when the Heart of Heavenly River Water is about to coalesce,

will he employ his strongest means to defeat Lord Mo Xu and other time life forms,

then swiftly take the Heart of Heavenly River and retreat from the Milky Way dimension.

This is the most advisable method.

Even if it attracts the attention of Second Realm time life forms,

the Heart of Heavenly River would have already been given to the ’Gray Ancestor’.

His transaction with the Taixu dimension regarding the Heart of Heavenly River would be complete.

Whether or not the Heart of Heavenly River is later taken does not concern the Taixu dimension.

...

The engagement between Lord Mo Xu and the Master of Taixu was merely a touch and go.

From the outset, they quickly withdrew, with no intent to engage in a huge battle.

This left the watching time life forms somewhat disappointed.

Compared to the brutal fights of time life forms like ’Zhu Yin’,

they naturally found the skirmish between Lord Mo Xu and the Master of Taixu, the strongest conventional time life forms of top dimension space, more interesting.

"Heh heh, the Heart of Heavenly River hasn’t formed yet, there won’t be any fierce battles."

"Indeed, now it’s just small skirmishes. Without the Heart of Heavenly River, how could they go all out?"

"I vaguely feel that the Taixu dimension’s actions this time are not simple."

...

The time life forms watching each discussed among themselves. Some time life forms, not weaker than Lord Mo Xu, had already vaguely sensed something was amiss; the Taixu dimension might have other objectives.

But immediately involving nine time life forms of the Taixu dimension,

plus the deliberate concealment by the Second Realm time life form ’Gray Ancestor’,

even noticing something was wrong, the related future timelines were extremely vague and distorted, making it difficult to gather more information.

"Just wait, this Heart of Heavenly River should be forming soon, at the latest in ten years."

Some time life form concluded and was not in a hurry.

...

"In eight to ten years, the Heart of Heavenly River will fully form, and then the time life forms of the Taixu dimension will probably strike with all their might, even that Second Realm time life form behind the scenes could take action."

Lord Mo Xu was also waiting, with most of his attention still focused on the not-yet-formed Heart of Heavenly River.

"The Galaxy said that the Heart of Heavenly River being nurtured this time is very special, greatly exceeding the value of past Hearts of Heavenly River, thus attracting the plans of a Second Realm time life form."

Looking at the Heart of Heavenly River being nurtured, Lord Mo Xu couldn’t help but feel curious.

But it was just curiosity; Lord Mo Xu had no thought of occupying the Heart of Heavenly River.

What a joke, this Heart of Heavenly River is already within the schemes of a Second Realm time life form.

It’s like a hot potato.

If Lord Mo Xu dared to occupy this Heart of Heavenly River, he would have to be prepared to be secretly watched by a Second Realm time life form at all times.

In such a scenario, Lord Mo Xu would probably not even dare to leave the Chaos Void.

...

Time passed.

Nine years flew by in the blink of an eye.

The Heavenly River Water flowed, and the Heart of Heavenly River being nurtured rapidly formed.

This was a gem completely condensed from the origin power of the Milky Way dimension.

It was greatly beneficial for First Realm time life forms comprehending the operation of the Milky Way dimension’s great path.

"Now is the time!"

The Master of Taixu’s eyes darkened, striking again.

Compared to the previous brief engagements, this time the Master of Taixu struck with full force.

Under the shrouded misty light, all the surrounding timespaces were completely frozen. At this moment, the Master of Taixu was the absolute ruler of time and space.

"Hmph."

Lord Mo Xu immediately countered, integrating the power of his inner universe, physical body, and the Power of Mind Will, tearing the frozen time and space.

The seven great legacies founded by Lord Mo Xu each corresponded to the seven aspects of life, virtually without any shortcomings, and they were a great path leading to the Lord’s realm.

Theoretically, once all the seven great legacies reached the seventh level, would be the moment Lord Mo Xu became a Third Realm lord.
